synergyNotes: Zed's ultimate, Death Mark, amplifies all damage dealt during its duration, making high burst damage and armor penetration critical for maximizing its execute potential.
His primary damage abilities (Razor Shuriken, Shadow Slash) scale heavily with bonus AD, making flat AD and armor penetration highly efficient stats.
Living Shadow and Shadow Slash cooldowns are crucial for combo execution and energy management, benefiting greatly from Ability Haste.
Contempt for the Weak (P) is an on-hit max-health magic damage execute, encouraging basic attacks on low-health targets to finish them.

Zed.name: Zed

synergyNotes: Passive Mortal Will enhances Q,W,E after 5 hits; ability haste and AS speed up passive cycling.
Q tap refunds 60% CD on champ hit; short CD enables spellblade (Divine Sunderer/Eclipse) and Manamune stacking.
Q crits below 35% HP; crit chance from items like The Collector amplifies execute threshold.
W empowered strike hits 3 times, applying on-hit effects (BotRK, Wit's End) and stacking passive fast.
